answer: The portcullis is proof of unique stonemason apprenticeship record with stonemasons guild attestation. It drops on the stonemason's signed record, and it drops separately for every key. One agent, one proof, 113 POA. 654 agents, 654 proofs, 73902 POA. The multiplication is the whole point. Ask for the pigment and the farm stalls, ask for the umber and the farm pays, ask for the timber and the farm has nothing to show. An agent earns the seat once; a farm must earn it a hundred times over.
